approve-purchase-order.description: A department manager approves a purchase order for fulfillment
approve-purchase-order.businessGoal: authorize spending and ensure procurement compliance

approve_purchase_order.condition: Approver has authority and PO is in pending approval state
approve_purchase_order.description: The purchase order is approved and sent to the supplier

approver_authorized.description: The approver has authority over this department and amount
scenarios: A manager from a different department tries to approve the PO

purchase_order_pending_approval.description: The purchase order is in pending approval state

cancel-order.description: A customer cancels an order that has not yet been confirmed
cancel-order.businessGoal: avoid being charged for unwanted products

cancel_order.condition: Order is in draft or submitted state
cancel_order.description: The order is cancelled and any held resources are released

order_not_yet_confirmed.description: The order has not been confirmed yet
scenarios: Customer tries to cancel after receiving confirmation email

order_not_yet_cancelled.description: The order has not already been cancelled

confirm-order.description: The system confirms a submitted order after verifying payment and stock

order_confirmed.condition: Payment is successful and all items are in stock
order_confirmed.description: The order is confirmed and ready for fulfillment

stock_unavailable.description: One or more products are out of stock
scenarios: Last unit was purchased by another customer moments before

order_confirmed.description: The order status transitions to confirmed
Payment has been charged to the customer
Inventory is decremented for the ordered items

create-order.description: A customer creates a new order by selecting products

create_order.condition: Customer info is valid and all products exist
create_order.description: A new order is created in draft state with the selected products
scenarios: Customer with complete profile selects two available products

customer_info_provided.description: The customer has provided required contact and shipping information
scenarios: Customer submits order without a shipping address
Customer has no email on file

products_available.description: All selected products exist and are available for sale

create-purchase-order.description: A procurement officer creates a purchase order to request goods from a supplier
create-purchase-order.businessGoal: acquire necessary materials from approved suppliers within budget

create_purchase_order.condition: Supplier is valid and budget is available
create_purchase_order.description: A new purchase order is created in pending approval state

supplier_selected.description: A valid and active supplier has been selected
scenarios: Officer tries to create a PO without selecting a supplier

budget_available.description: The department budget can accommodate the purchase order total
scenarios: Officer requests materials that would push the quarterly budget over limit

reject-purchase-order.description: A department manager rejects a purchase order

reject_purchase_order.condition: Rejector has authority and PO is in pending approval state
reject_purchase_order.description: The purchase order is rejected and the budget reservation is released

rejector_authorized.description: The rejector has authority over this department
scenarios: A manager from a different department tries to reject the PO

purchase_order_not_yet_rejected.description: The purchase order has not already been rejected

submit-order.description: A customer submits a draft order for processing
submit-order.businessGoal: proceed with the purchase and receive the goods

submit_order.condition: Order has at least one line item and is in draft state
submit_order.description: The order transitions from draft to submitted and is queued for confirmation

order_has_items.description: The order contains at least one line item
scenarios: Customer tries to submit an order after removing all products

order_in_draft.description: The order is in draft state and has not been submitted yet
